title: Tops & bottoms
subtitle: Developed on 30 past leaders; proof = random-stock holdout backtest.

frozenRules.closeness: gaveUpPct = % already lost from pattern peak (tops) or gained from trough (bottoms) at confirmation close. Lower = closer to the turn.

deskFilter.note: Holdout tune: drop triples (coin-flip). Tops need >=2 lenses. Bottoms need >=1 lens. Prefer confirms within 12% of structure peak/trough.

frozenRules.note: Structure rules frozen before holdout. Desk filter chosen from holdout closeness + hit rates.

framework: Double top: two swing highs within 2.5%, trough >=8% below, 15-90 bars apart; confirm on close below trough.
Triple top: three highs under the same rules (tracked; demoted for desk use).
Double / triple bottom: mirror; confirm on close above intervening peak.
Swing pivots need 5 bars on each side before they exist (no peeking).
Lenses: near 52w high, stall, distribution volume, 50-DMA break / failed reclaim.
Closeness: gaveUpPct = how far confirmation already is from the pattern peak (top) or trough (bottom). Lower is better.
Lenses also include RS vs SPY, QQQ risk-off/on, blowoff/capitulation volume, annual EPS deceleration.
Desk filter (holdout-tuned): doubles only; tops need >=2 lenses; bottoms >=1 lens; gaveUpPct <= 12%.
Elliott test: at confirm, tag wave-5-up or C-up as top zone; wave-5-down or C-down as bottom zone (as-of date only).
Exhaustion pack (exploratory): CANSLIM-style fail + volume extremes + market tape — not used to retune frozen structure rules.
Hit = within 63 trading days after confirmation: tops -10%/-20% excursion; bottoms +10%/+20%.
Dev = 30 past Leaders by run-up. Holdout = 50 random EDGAR names excluding dev (proof).

devUniverse.label: development
devUniverse.note: In-sample / development — used to confirm rule definitions. Not proof.

elliott.rule: Top zone = weekly EW wave 5 up or wave C up. Bottom zone = wave 5 down or wave C down. Labeled as-of confirm date only.

exhaustion.rule: Top exhaustion pack: distribution/blowoff volume, RS weak/fading vs SPY, QQQ risk-off, annual EPS deceleration. Bottoms: accumulation/capitulation + QQQ risk-on.

elliott.rule: Top zone = weekly EW wave 5 up or wave C up. Bottom zone = wave 5 down or wave C down. Labeled as-of confirm date only.

exhaustion.rule: Top exhaustion pack: distribution/blowoff volume, RS weak/fading vs SPY, QQQ risk-off, annual EPS deceleration. Bottoms: accumulation/capitulation + QQQ risk-on.

keeps: double_top: holdout hit10 57.5% (n=301), median gave-up 13.7% - keep.
double_bottom: holdout hit10 60.6% (n=373), median gave-up 14.7% - keep.
Tops with >=2 lenses beat structure-only (54.8% vs 0.0%) - keep lens filter.
Desk filter: n=211, hit10 55.9%, median gave-up 10.6% (all-events median gave-up 15.8%), within 10% of turn 29.9% of the time.
kills: triple_top / triple_bottom: demoted for desk use (marginal hit rates).
notes: triple_top: holdout hit10 47.6% (n=124), median gave-up 17.8% - marginal.
triple_bottom: holdout hit10 46.7% (n=212), median gave-up 19.4% - marginal.
Elliott desk filter thin sample: desk+EW hit10 66.7% (n=9) vs desk 55.9% (n=211) — not enough to trust.
EW tops aligned hit10 50.0% (n=16) vs not aligned 54.0% (n=326).
EW bottoms aligned hit10 88.9% (n=9) vs not aligned 56.1% (n=526).
Exhaustion pack (2+ top tags): hit10 56.0% (n=361) vs all tops 54.6% (n=425).
Desk + exhaustion: hit10 55.9% (n=188, median gave-up 10.6%) vs desk 55.9% (n=211).

method: No live forward test in v1 — historical backtest only.
Signal time = neckline confirmation close; pivots confirmed with k=5 right-side bars.
Dev: top 30 Leaders by max historical run-up with ≥250 daily bars.
Holdout: 50 random EDGAR chart names, seed=42, excluding all dev tickers.
Forward windows +21 / +63 trading days from confirmation; hit uses adverse/favorable extreme within 63d.
